title: Sambucus nigra tincture for medicinal use
intro: Sambucus nigra tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the berries of the European elder tree. It is commonly used in herbalism for its antiviral, anti-inflammatory, and immune-supporting properties. This preparation is often employed to alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and respiratory infections. It may also be used topically to treat skin conditions and reduce fever. Due to its potent nature, it is typically diluted before use to ensure safety and efficacy.
